name: dejuna
noteEs: Cubre el lado cosmético y de live-service de Marvel Rivals: skins nuevas, contenido del battle pass, Twitch Drops y noticias de roadmap y leaks. Es un carril editorial distinto al de los canales de gameplay y meta: es para jugadores que coleccionan, persiguen skins gratis y quieren saber qué viene, más que tier lists. Un buen complemento que redondea la cobertura de noticias con foco en cosméticos.
noteEn: Covers the cosmetic and live-service side of Marvel Rivals: new skins, battle-pass content, Twitch Drops, and roadmap and leak news. It's a distinct editorial lane from the gameplay and meta channels: it's for players who collect, chase free skins, and want to know what's coming, rather than tier lists. A good complement that rounds out the directory's news coverage with a cosmetics focus.
highlightsEs: Cobertura dedicada de skins, cosméticos y battle pass
Walkthroughs de Twitch Drops y eventos de skins gratis
Noticias de roadmap, contenido próximo y leaks
Uploads diarios que mantienen frescas las noticias de cosméticos
highlightsEn: Dedicated coverage of skins, cosmetics, and the battle pass
Twitch Drops and free-skin event walkthroughs
Daily uploads that keep cosmetic news fresh
